Sets itself as a launch daemon for persistence between OS reboots
Creates a Python script that opens a reverse shell to server at 185.243.115.230:1337
Asks user for root password and saves it in cleartext in /Users/Shared/dumpdummy and /tmp/dumpdummy
Reverse shell gives attacker access to infected hosts
